title: Scout gets another recovery route
summary:
Scout and Economics got recovery fixes, two community apps joined the catalog, and the image API reference gained a model ID.

Llama 4 Scout now tries a pinned DeepInfra route before Novita when its primary provider fails. The fallback applies to both chat completions and Responses requests; pricing and capabilities are unchanged.

The Economics dashboard no longer lets a stalled journal request block later loads. Completed snapshots are cached, failed refreshes preserve the previous snapshot until it expires, and prolonged loads lead to a Retry screen.

Community submissions added Complimentik, a Russian-language compliment generator, and FX Trade Setup Studio, which turns currency trade details into visual cards.
